answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24989 Country: India Title: Somebody told me it is afzal for a hanafi woman to pray Isha in the last third portion of the night? Is that true? Question: Somebody told me it is afzal for a hanafi woman to pray Isha in the last third portion of the night ? Is that true ? Answer ID: 24989 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1376/1376/M=1431) It is not right because after midnight, the time of Isha turns makrooh and the rewards are lessened; hence, one should not delay the isha salah to that time. However, it is better to offer Isha salah before one-third part of night passes. Yes, if one has any excuse, it is different matter. This ruling is for all whether male or female. و تاخير العشاء إلى ما قبل ثلث الليل مستحب و إلى ما بعده إلى نصف الليل مباح و إلى ما بعده إلى طلوع الفجر مكروه إذا كان بغير عذر (منيه). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
